topic.title: Wrap Against Edit
topic.shortdesc: User A only changes the nesting of existing content. User B only edits the text inside it.

body.p: Set auth.signing.key in the properties file before every restart.
Use the authctl command-line tool to validate the configuration.
The property auth.token.ttl.seconds controls how long an access token stays valid.
The Authentication Service verifies user credentials and issues short-lived signed access tokens.
It runs as a stateless component and can be scaled horizontally behind a load balancer.

section.title: Configuring the service
section.p: The configuration file is read once, at startup.

note.p: A hot reload of the configuration file is not supported in any release.

section.p: Restart the service after every change.
